name: planqc
description: planqc is a German quantum computing startup developing atom-based quantum computers using optical lattices. Spun out of the Max Planck Institute of Quantum Optics, planqc aims to build scalable quantum processors with thousands of qubits for industrial applications.

products.name: Optical Lattice QPU
products.description: Neutral-atom quantum processor using optical lattices for scalable quantum computing with thousands of qubits

highlights: Spin-off from Max Planck Institute of Quantum Optics, a world leader in cold atom research
Partnered with DLR to build Europe's first digital quantum computer using neutral atoms
EUR 50M+ raised to develop industrial-scale atom-based quantum processors

news.excerpt: Spin-off of Max Planck Institute of Quantum Optics recognized for neutral atom quantum computing technology and industrial applications

news.title: planqc to lead €20M BMBF-funded project to build 1,000-qubit quantum computer for Leibniz Supercomputing Centre
news.excerpt: The MAQCS project, funded by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research, will integrate planqc's neutral-atom dual-core platform with the Leibniz Supercomputing Centre in Munich, targeting 1,000 qubits.
